args.summary: A malformed message lacking an `order_id` field is repeatedly picked up by the fulfillment service consumer and failing with a KeyError. Because it fails and becomes visible again after the visibility timeout, it remains in flight and ages the queue without successfully processing or moving to the dead-letter queue (likely due to max receive count settings or re-deliveries).
args.proposed_actions: Investigate how the malformed message without an order_id got into the placed-orders queue, or redrive/remove it if necessary.
